# PipeWire GStreamer plugin

Unmodified `src/gst/*.[ch]` from PipeWire 1.4.9, MIT license in COPYING.
Source: https://codeload.github.com/PipeWire/pipewire/tar.gz/refs/tags/1.4.9
Archive SHA256: 8066a7b220069e4c6e3b02bd2b6ea303bba66df255023c07c99323449ba8fe3c
